evidence_seq.description: The visible tool-result sequence that grounds a finding; 0 only for no_finding.

anchor.description: The smallest exact implementation location that owns or reveals the gap: a code identifier, function, field, or state transition.

relationship.description: One short Traditional Chinese declarative sentence stating one still-open, packet-grounded engineering edge: the unmet runtime dependency and its task-breaking runtime behavior. The Host renders the principle, warning marker, and anchor separately.
